episodeTitle.en: Billion dollar failures, and billion dollar success | Tom Conrad (Quibi, Pandora, Pets.com, Zero)
episodeTitle.zh: 百亿美元的失败与百亿美元的成功 | 汤姆·康拉德（Quibi、Pandora、Pets.com、Zero）

guestBioOfficial.en: Tom Conrad is the CEO of Zero and on the board of Sonos. He began his career in engineering at Apple, where he helped build key features that remain in iOS today. Tom was previously the VP of Product at Snap and the chief technology officer of Pandora. He also held leadership positions at notable tech flops Pets.com and Quibi, giving him a unique perspective not only on what it takes to build a successful company but also on lessons from failure. In today’s conversation, we discuss: • Lessons learned from the infamous failures of Pets.com and Quibi
guestBioOfficial.zh:
汤姆·康拉德（Tom Conrad）是Zero公司的首席执行官，同时也是Sonos董事会成员。他的职业生涯始于苹果公司，曾参与开发至今仍保留在iOS系统中的关键功能。此前，他曾担任Snap的副总裁以及Pandora的首席技术官，还在科技界的失败案例Pets.com和Quibi中担任过领导职务。这段经历不仅让他深刻领悟了成功企业的构建之道，也让他从失败中汲取了宝贵经验。在今天的对话中，我们将探讨：
• 从Pets.com和Quibi这些臭名昭著的失败案例中吸取的教训

title.en: Billion dollar failures, and billion dollar success | Tom Conrad (Quibi, Pandora, Pets.com, Zero)
title.zh: 百亿美元的失败与百亿美元的成功 | 汤姆·康拉德（Quibi、Pandora、Pets.com、Zero）

summary.en: Tom reflects on lessons from both billion-dollar failures (Pets.com, Quibi) and billion-dollar successes (Apple, Pandora, Snap), including why not everyone needs to be a founder. He shares how to choose where to work, the math of a business, and how to avoid burnout while building. The episode is a rare, story-rich blend of failure and success from a true operator.
summary.zh: Tom 反思了十亿美元级失败（Pets.com、Quibi）与十亿美元级成功（Apple、Pandora、Snap）中的经验，包括为什么并非人人都需要成为创始人。他分享了如何选择供职的公司、生意背后的数学逻辑，以及如何在打造产品的同时避免职业倦怠。本期是一位真正从业者对失败与成功的、富含故事的罕见融合。
